Room by Room

The work, space by space

Every AK Gatsios project starts with the room as it’s actually lived in — how it’s cooked in, steamed in, and seen from the street. Explore the three specialties below. Photography shown is representative imagery illustrating scope and finishes, not AK Gatsios project photos.

Kitchens that work as hard as they look

Full gut renovations and smart refreshes — layout, cabinetry, stone, and lighting planned as one system, so the room cooks better, not just photographs better.

  • Custom & semi-custom cabinetry, fitted on site
  • Stone countertops and waterfall islands
  • Layout changes, lighting plans, and appliance integration
  • Tile, flooring, and finish carpentry by the same crew
White oakMarble & quartzBrass fixturesPro ranges

Start a kitchen project

Bathrooms built like small spas

Travertine, stone, and glass — with the unglamorous work done right underneath: waterproofing, drainage, and ventilation that keep a beautiful bathroom beautiful.

  • Full bathroom remodels and walk-in tub conversions
  • Travertine & porcelain tile, expertly set and grouted
  • Glass rain showers, soaking tubs, and floating vanities
  • Plumbing, waterproofing, and ventilation handled in-house
TravertineRain showersSoaking tubsWalnut vanities

Start a bathroom project

Exteriors that protect the whole house

Siding and roofing are the home’s weather system. AK Gatsios replaces both — and the gutters, trim, and flashing between them — so the envelope works as one.

  • Vinyl, fiber-cement, wood, brick & stone siding — install or replace
  • Asphalt shingle, metal, slate & flat roofing — install, replace, repair
  • Seamless gutters, skylights, and exterior doors & windows
  • Porticos, decks, and porches built or rebuilt
Fiber-cement sidingArchitectural shinglesSeamless guttersStone porticos

What We Do

Four specialties, one accountable crew

No hand-offs to strangers. The team that scopes your project is the team that builds it — licensed, insured, and on the job every day until it’s done.

01

Kitchens

Gut renovations and refreshes: cabinetry, stone, tile, lighting, and layout changes that make the hardest-working room in the house earn its keep.

Get estimate →
02

Bathrooms

Tile and stone bathrooms, walk-in showers, soaking tubs, and full remodels — waterproofed and ventilated properly, finished beautifully.

Get estimate →
03

Siding

Old siding off, new siding on — vinyl, fiber-cement, wood, brick, or stone — with trim, flashing, and insulation detailed for NYC weather.

Get estimate →
04

Roofing

Leak response, repair, and full replacement across shingle, metal, slate, and flat roofs — plus seamless gutters and skylights.

Get estimate →

Also on the roster: basement and whole-home remodeling, additions, flooring, windows and doors, decks and porticos, painting, waterproofing, and concrete work — if it’s part of the house, one call covers it.
